name: River Self-Hosted Job Queue
free_limit: MPL-2.0 open-source job queue running with PostgreSQL or SQLite; no hosted usage quota; includes transactional enqueueing, retries, scheduled/periodic jobs and multiple queues.
watch_out: Self-managed database and worker compute are required; hosting costs are not included. MPL-2.0 obligations apply when distributing modified source files; managed support is separate.
